result: The standard toolkit the survey builds on: for an L-smooth function the descent lemma makes a gradient step of size 1/L lower f by ‖∇f‖²/(2L), so gradient descent finds an ε-stationary point in O(ε^{−2}) steps even without convexity; convexity adds that stationary points are global minima.
result_plain: Textbook background: L-smoothness, descent lemma, GD reaches ‖∇f‖ ≤ ε in O(ε^-2) steps without convexity.
